title: Introduce cost-harvester: adaptive sample collector and quant suggestion pipeline
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: We need a lightweight production-side sampler and analytic pipeline that harvests representative request slices across tenants and time windows to drive automated quantization recommendations and targeted batching/caching defaults. Existing tools rely on coarse workload summaries which miss long-tail segments where quantization provides outsized unit-econ wins. This PR adds the 'cost-harvester' pipeline: an adaptive sampler instrument, a small in-cluster aggregator, a simulation-friendly cost model, and a suggestion engine that outputs conservative per-tenant quant and batching presets. It is designed for safety-first rollout and integrates with Redwood Optimize and the Console UI. What changed: 1) redwood/econ/harvester: new sampler service that attaches light-weight sampling hooks to the request router and periodically emits anonymized signatures, sequence-length histograms, KV cache hit patterns, and latency/cost deltas. 2) redwood/econ/aggregator: local aggregator that deduplicates and aggregates samples into worker-friendly segments. 3) redwood/sim/cost_model: a deterministic cost simulator that computes delta unit-econ for candidate quant profiles and batch sizes given sample segments. 4) redwood/optimize/integration: suggestion API that consumes simulation output and emits safe presets, with conservative thresholds and rollback metadata. 5) console/docs: Console UI changes to show harvester-suggested presets and a lightweight simulation preview; docs and onboarding guide for Safe Rollouts. Migration: Harvester is off by default. Admins opt-in per-tenant. Default suggestions are marked "audit" and must be approved in Console before automated application. Rollout plan: staged internal rollout (dev -> canary tenants -> 10% of production) with feature flag and kill-switch. Testing: unit tests for sampler + aggregator, deterministic integration tests for cost_model, end-to-end smoke test using synthetic replay harness. Performance: sampler adds ~0.2%-0.5% p50 added CPU in our lab traces at 1% sampling. Safety: all samples are sanitized, payloads truncated, and no customer PII is exported. Checklist: - [x] sampler and aggregator implementation - [x] deterministic cost model + test vectors - [x] suggestion API + conservative thresholds - [x] Console preview and docs - [x] e2e smoke tests - [x] feature flag and kill switch - [x] changelog entry

review_thread: Aisha: Please add a circuit-breaker for aggregator memory spikes. Response: added max-batch-bytes and eviction policy in collector.go and tests. Tomás: Clarify sampling budget config and telemetry cardinality. Response: added tenant-level sampling caps and cardinality guard with deterministic bucketing. Jordan: Request to add deterministic seed for simulator for reproducible results. Response: simulator now accepts seed param and test vectors added. Approval: Aisha approved after mem-safeguards, Tomás approved after telemetry docs, Jordan approved after deterministic tests.
release_notes: New 'cost-harvester' adaptive sampler and suggestion pipeline that produces conservative quantization and batching presets per-tenant. Off by default; admins must opt-in. Safe rollout via Console preview and approve flow. Includes deterministic cost simulator for previewing unit-econ impact.
notes_for_ops: Feature is behind feature flag feature.cost_harvester.enabled. Default sampling rate is 0.1% globally and configurable per-tenant. Monitor harvester.sampler.cpu and harvester.aggregator.mem metrics. Kill-switch: feature.cost_harvester.kill=true. Suggested alert: aggregator.mem > 75% of configured limit for 2m.
